subject: Trial win criteria playbook and kickoff schedule
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial win criteria playbook and kickoff schedule

Hi Elena — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward a successful POC: 

Summary of call
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference can meet Novacorp's 99th-percentile latency targets for your anonymized batch and streaming workloads while keeping per-token cost below $0.0009.
- Key stakeholders: Elena (platform), Diego (procurement), Data Science (TBD).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: 99th percentile <= 350ms for 2k token streaming tests.
2) Throughput: sustained 500 qps for short-burst evaluation window.
3) Output quality: BLEU-style automated checks + 10 curated prompt spot checks with >= 92% acceptance.
4) Integration: SDK-based inference in your staging environment with prefix caching enabled.

Suggested timeline (flexible):
- Kickoff & environment access: week of Apr 26 (propose 4/26 afternoon PT)
- Week 1: fast integration & baseline runs
- Weeks 2–3: tuning (batching, quant profiles) + acceptance tests
- Week 4: final readout & decision

Owners (initial):
- Redwood lead (technical): Marissa Cole — integration & acceptance testing
- Redwood engagement lead: Jonas Weber — success criteria, timelines, commercial coordination
- Novacorp technical lead: Elena Gomez — test data & staging access
- Novacorp procurement: Diego / procurement@novacorp.com — SOW/PO cadence

Attachments: draft SOW (redwood-poc-sow-v1.pdf) and a candidate milestone schedule (novacorp-poc-schedule.xlsx) are attached. I also added a Drive folder for shared artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_novacorp-poc

Ask: Can you confirm the success criteria above and whether Apr 26 works for a 45-minute kickoff? If procurement needs a PO timeline, loop them in and we’ll fast-track the SOW via DocuSign.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novacorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Alvarez <diego.alvarez@novacorp.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial win criteria playbook and kickoff schedule

Thanks Jonas — helpful recap. A few clarifications/questions from our side: 

1) The latency target looks reasonable but we’ll need to validate on our mixed-request distribution (attached sample trace). Can Marissa walk us through how prefix caching affects 99p in streaming?
2) For output quality: instead of BLEU, can we use an internal rubric tied to our customer-facing responses? We’ll share a 10-prompt set by EOD 4/20.
3) Procurement timeline: Diego here — we usually need 10 business days to execute a PO after SOW sign. Can you confirm whether Redwood can start sandbox work under a short-form NDA or SOW pre-sign?

We’re OK with a kickoff the week of Apr 26 — 4/26 2:30pm PT should work for Marissa and me, pending Diego’s PO question.

Elena
Platform Engineering Lead
Novacorp

Elena — I’ll take the lead on the technical acceptance plan. A few concrete notes and an abbreviated runbook below. Happy to walk through this in kickoff.

Technical acceptance plan (high level)
- Data & access: We just need staging API keys and a pointer to your anonymized test bucket (S3). No customer PII required for this evaluation.
- Baseline run: 1 day — ingest sample traces, run cold cache, measure 50/95/99p latencies.
- Tuning window: 3 days — test batching + KV caching + 8-bit quant profile; capture cost delta.
- Quality validation: 2 days — run automated checks + 10 human spot checks your team provides.

Weekly cadence & check-ins
- Kickoff (4/26 14:30 PT) — 45m: alignment, access, initial baseline plan
- Weekly syncs (Thursdays, 30m) — quick blockers and decisions
- Midpoint check (end of Week 2) — deep readout of tuning results
- Final readout (end of Week 4) — demos, metrics, recommended config for prod rollout

Owners and responsibilities
- Integration & baseline: Marissa Cole (Redwood) + Novacorp staging lead
- Tuning & perf: Marissa + Rishi Malhotra (Redwood SE support)
- Success criteria & commercial: Jonas Weber
- Eval acceptance & sign-off: Elena + Novacorp DS rep (TBD)

Quick ask for kickoff prep
- Elena: sample 10 prompts + representative trace by 4/20 EOD
- Diego/procurement: any redlines to the SOW noted in advance so we can align with legal
- Novacorp infra: staging API key + S3 bucket read link (temporary)

I uploaded a short milestone swimlane to the Drive and attached the schedule here (novacorp-poc-schedule.xlsx). If procurement can’t commit to the PO timeline, we can provision a short-term sandbox access under our evaluation terms while SOW is in-flight — please confirm with Diego.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
